correctness.rationale: Conditional on the published spectral-gap guarantee c_m=2m/[3(m-1)(m-2)] and published Theorem 3.5 conversion, the sufficient feasibility inequality 6/[m(m-1)]<c_m reduces to (m-3)(m-6)>0 for m>3. Substitution gives alpha_m=2(m-6)/[3(m^2-4)]. Exact difference alpha_(m+1)-alpha_m has numerator 2(-m^2+11m+2), changing sign between m=11 and 12, proving a unique integer maximum m=12 at 1/35. The tolerant conversion sqrt(3/alpha) gives sqrt(105), while alpha_7=2/135; gain 27/14. Independent Fraction computations verified the values and difference for m=7..199. These prove the algebraic optimization, not the underlying new bosonic spectral-gap lemma; the primary full text could not be accessed in this run.
